title: AlgoEvo: Self-Evolving Agentic Search for Automated Algorithm Discovery
abstract: arXiv:2609.15820v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Large language models have advanced automated algorithm discovery by synthesizing executable code, but existing frameworks trap them in rigid search pipelines with pre-defined control flows. This limitation restricts adaptive reasoning, blocks cross-paradigm transfer, and discards valuable execution feedback. We propose AlgoEvo, a unified agentic framework that transforms automated algorithm discovery into an interactive, knowledge-accumulating process. An autonomous agent dynamically inspects, diagnoses, and edits code based on runtime feedback. A design skill hub decouples paradigm-specific knowledge from the core discovery engine, allowing a single workflow to seamlessly handle single-objective, multi-objective, and multi-component design. translated_title: AlgoEvo：面向自动化算法发现的自进化智能体搜索
translated_abstract: arXiv:2609.15820v1 公告类型：新。摘要：大型语言模型通过合成可执行代码推动了自动化算法发现的发展，但现有框架将其束缚在具有预定义控制流程的僵化搜索管道中。这一局限限制了自适应推理，阻碍了跨范式迁移，并丢弃了有价值的执行反馈。我们提出 AlgoEvo，这是一个统一的智能体框架，将自动化算法发现转变为一个交互式、知识积累的过程。自主智能体基于运行时反馈动态地检查、诊断和编辑代码。设计技能中心将特定范式的知识与核心发现引擎解耦，使单一工作流能够无缝处理单目标、多目标和多组件设计。同时，分层经验机制将搜索轨迹组织成任务级树以指导探索，并将跨任务模式整合为可复用的技能。在六个代表性……（原文截断）
tldr: AlgoEvo 提出了一个自进化的智能体搜索框架，将自动化算法发现转化为交互式、知识积累的过程，通过基于运行时反馈的自主代码诊断编辑、解耦范式知识的技能中心以及分层经验机制，实现跨单目标、多目标和多组件设计的统一算法发现。
en_tdlr: AlgoEvo is a self-evolving agentic search framework that transforms automated algorithm discovery into an interactive, knowledge-accumulating process, featuring autonomous runtime-feedback-driven code diagnosis and editing, a paradigm-decoupled skill hub, and a hierarchical experience mechanism that unifies single-objective, multi-objective, and multi-component algorithm discovery.
